'''Acceleration Coils''' were components used in [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] weaponry, including the [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|rifle]] and [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|pistol]] models. The component was located at the front of the weapon, just behind the [[Beam Emitter]].<ref name="EGWT" />
